title: Audit learner magazine article detail screen

acceptance.text: Open a real seeded magazine article through the visible learner UI; verify content and metadata render in vi/en/ja, including the seeded Japanese/Vietnamese introduction; persist article vocabulary to a learner-owned flashcard deck without modifying master vocabulary; verify mini-quiz answer/result states and saved read score, mobile layout at 390x844, and missing-article behavior separately from operational failures. Persist anonymous/authenticated/mobile evidence and fixes in the inventory.

The dynamic public article route returns published article content, ordered vocabulary with stable row IDs, quiz options/correct answer feedback data, and a valid published timestamp; the visible localized page renders the article and quiz on desktop/mobile; quiz completion persists read state and score/total through the authenticated API; learner flashcard creation persists only learner-owned rows; missing slugs remain 404 while upstream/network failures surface as operational errors. The flashcard endpoint must also reject vocabulary whose parent magazine article is unpublished.

spec.expected_behavior: GET /api/magazine/{slug} returns the published article, its ordered vocabItems and quizzes in the fields consumed by the UI, and a valid publishedAt. The public UI renders content and localized dates; authenticated quiz completion persists quiz score and total in daily.magazine_user_read, and invalid slugs return 404. A magazine vocabulary source is eligible for flashcard creation only while its parent article is published.
spec.observed_behavior: The Go detail handler returned only metadata and contentJson, omitting the child vocabulary and quiz rows; the learner screen rendered Invalid Date and no article body/vocabulary/quiz. POST /api/magazine/{slug}/read wrote to a retired daily.magazine_read table, discarded the quiz body, ignored SQL errors, and returned read:true. The canonical Prisma-owned table is daily.magazine_user_read.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the focused Go detail/read contract, learner article date/localized label changes, and their tests together. Local canonical seed data is idempotent and may remain for future screen audits.

classification.rationale: The active learner article page receives a reduced detail DTO, formats a missing date as Invalid Date, and quiz completion writes to a retired table while discarding score fields. Fix the source contract and persistence path with PostgreSQL integration and visible browser retests. Removing the retired SQL also requires shrinking the canonical SQL drift baseline.
